_note: Visualization-only correlations that shape the 3D flame from engine outputs (Q_W, burning area, front, flow, gravity). They never feed the engine or any reported number. verified=false until the human spot-check (docs/HUMAN_TASKS.md).

heskestad.source: Heskestad, G. (1983). Luminous heights of turbulent diffusion flames. Fire Safety Journal 5, 103-108.

gravity_length_exponent.units: L_f proportional to (g/g0)^value at fixed Q
gravity_length_exponent.source: Froude scaling of buoyant diffusion flames: Q* = Q / (rho cp T sqrt(g D) D^2), L_f/D = f(Q*) with L_f ~ Q^(2/5) (Heskestad 1983). Partial gravity = bounded estimate.

puffing.units: f [Hz] = c / sqrt(D[m]) at 1 g, scaled by sqrt(g/g0)
puffing.source: Cetegen, B.M. & Ahmed, T.A. (1993). Experiments on the periodic instability of buoyant plumes and pool fires. Combustion and Flame 93, 157-184.

alpha_film_m2_s.units: m^2/s, thermal diffusivity of air at 800 K (flame film temperature)
alpha_film_m2_s.source: Incropera, DeWitt, Bergman & Lavine, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Table A.4 (air, 800 K).

sheath_visible_multiple.units: visible flame thickness = value * alpha / u_rel (illustrative)
sheath_visible_multiple.source: design input (illustrative): visible sheath spans several diffusion lengths alpha/u of an opposed-flow flame

flame_length_max_m.source: design input (display bound inside the 2.1 m aisle)
